name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 9 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-01-30, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
